mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_security ( event_type, severity, actor_id, client_ip, user_agent, request_uri, detail_json, trace_id, logged_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventType}, #{severity}, #{actorId}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{requestUri}, #{detailJson}, #{traceId}, COALESCE(#{loggedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.sql: log_security_id, event_type, severity, actor_id, client_ip, user_agent, request_uri, detail_json, trace_id, logged_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at

WHERE logged_at >= #{search.dateFrom} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{search.dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ( event_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR severity LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR actor_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR client_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR request_uri LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR detail_json LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM log_security
ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT #{search.pageSize} OFFSET #{search.offset}
SELECT FROM log_security WHERE log_security_id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM log_security WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY logged_at ASC LIMIT 200
